key_insight: Pathology foundation models retrieved similar salivary gland tumor cases without task-specific training, with Atlas2 achieving the highest reported retrieval performance.
clinical_relevance: Searching diagnosed case archives could support pathologists’ differential diagnosis of rare tumors, but this study evaluates case retrieval—not drug discovery or clinical outcomes.
method: Query a digitized archive using a manually or automatically selected whole-slide image region.
Use foundation-model representations to retrieve morphologically similar cases with ICD-O codes and slides.
Compare Atlas2, Atlas2-B, Atlas2-S and UNI2h using leave-one-case-out evaluation.
evidence_signal: Across 137 cases spanning 12 ICD-O morphology categories, Atlas2 achieved 62.5%, 76.7% and 81.3% Top-1, Top-3 and Top-5 retrieval, respectively.
watch_item: The small, imbalanced dataset and lack of reported external validation limit conclusions about performance in other pathology archives.
paper_title: Pathology foundation models for training-free case retrieval in salivary gland tumors
